description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a method for logging messages with various levels of detail and optional exception information. It is part of a logging framework, allowing customization and chaining of log outputs.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node in a chain of log handlers. Defines a method to output log data, potentially to various targets or filters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with given priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exception details.
